lines.text: The Lamb opens the first seal, and John sees a white horse whose rider holds a bow and is given a crown.
At the second seal, a bright red horse goes out, and its rider is given a great spear.
At the third seal, John sees a black horse whose rider holds a pair of scales.
At the fourth seal, John sees a pale green horse whose rider is named Legion, and Hades follows close behind.
At the sixth seal, a great earthquake comes, the sun turns black, and the whole moon turns blood red.
